title: Synthetic sample-level differential-expression handoff
rationale: Exercise the evidence-to-analysis connection with a simple synthetic contrast. Inspect the selected comparison and replace this text with its conditional rationale; this template does not establish a method recommendation.

dataset.label: Synthetic engineering demonstration: 200 cells, 80 genes, eight samples
dataset.provenance: Generated by examples/analysis-handoff/make_demo.py with seed 20261029. See generation.json for hashes and package versions. No biological observations or scientific benchmark labels.

environment.description: Proposed analysis environment specification. Its installation and H5AD input adapter must be verified before execution; it is not a resolved environment lock.

assumptions: All observations and sample labels are synthetic. Results cannot support biological conclusions.
Aggregate raw counts within the selected cell type by synthetic sample; do not treat cells as biological replicates.
The balanced contrast has four synthetic samples per condition, with no modeled batch or pairing. Real study design requires separate review.
Thresholds and resource requests are demonstration choices, not validated universal defaults.
Review the retained skill's statistical guidance and verify the dataset adapter and runtime before executing it.
